references.text: Crowds came to Jesus to hear him and be healed of their diseases, following the same pattern as in Luke 6:18.
Jesus drove out unclean spirits with authority, demonstrating his power over them as described in Luke 6:18.
Many sick people pressed forward to touch Jesus, and unclean spirits fell down before him—paralleling the crowd's desire for healing and deliverance from unclean spirits.
Jesus healed many who were sick and drove out many evil spirits, paralleling the healing of diseases and deliverance from unclean spirits in Luke 6:18.
People with various illnesses and afflictions, including those possessed and epileptics, were brought to Jesus, and he healed them, corresponding to the description in Luke 6:18.
Large crowds followed Jesus, and he healed all of them—parallel to people coming to be healed in Luke 6:18.
Jesus healed many of diseases, afflictions, and evil spirits, a direct parallel to the healing from sicknesses and unclean spirits in Luke 6:18.
Many with different illnesses were brought to Jesus, and he healed them; evil spirits also came out—this shows the same dual theme of healing and exorcism.
People from the towns around Jerusalem brought forward the sick and those troubled by unclean spirits, and all were healed—a pattern corresponding to Luke 6:18.
Wherever Jesus went, they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged to touch him, and all who touched him were healed—showing the crowds' desire for healing.
